project_title: Seni Musik XI - AI Music Class Journal & Automated Video Grading Platform
design_archetype: Organic & Modern Studio (Earthy Warm Ivory + Studio Amber Accent + Swiss Precision)

typography.heading_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, Cabinet Grotesk, sans-serif

heading_rules.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-tight
heading_rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900
heading_rules.overline: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-amber-700 bg-amber-100/80 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full w-max

typography.pairing_philosophy: Combine structured, warm sans-serif for headings with high-contrast readable sans for data tables and form inputs. Use monospace for video link handles, AI confidence scores, and raw metadata tags.

primary.description: Warm Studio Amber / Terracotta Gold - represents music craft & warm creative lighting

secondary.description: Deep Slate Indigo - for teacher command buttons and primary navigation headers

accent_rose.description: Grade D / Error or Missing submission rose

layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl for cards and panels, rounded-xl for inputs and buttons, rounded-full for status pills
layout_and_spacing.header_strategy: Sticky glassmorphic navbar with backdrop-blur-md bg-white/90 border-b border-amber-900/10 shadow-sm z-50

page_structure.public_submit: Centered modern card hero with dual language switcher (ID / EN), clean video platform preview, real-time URL detection badge (TikTok, IG, YouTube, FB), clear class selector XI 1 - XI 12, attendance input (1-40), and crisp state feedback.
page_structure.public_results: Public lookup form requiring Class selection + Attendance number. Displays published scores, grade breakdown (Content 50%, Delivery 30%, Technical 20%), strengths, and suggestions without exposing teacher notes or pending AI evaluations.
page_structure.teacher_dashboard: Header metric summary cards (Total Submissions, Graded, Pending, Avg Score, Top Class), filter bar (Class XI 1-12, Platform, Grade, Status, Search), dense high-utility journal table with batch actions, export CSV/Excel triggers, and quick toggle for public results page visibility.
page_structure.grading_modal: Side-by-side or stacked drawer featuring embedded oEmbed/video link preview, rubric slider/scores, Gemini 3.1 Pro generated commentary breakdown, manual override toggle, retry AI button, and publish switch.

content_and_context.description: Pemahaman harmoni, ketepatan nada, kesesuaian dengan tema 'Musik di Sekitar Kita'

delivery_and_subtitles.description: Ekspresi vokal/instrumen, kejelasan artikulasi, sinkronisasi teks/penjelasan video

technical_and_tagging.description: Kualitas audio-visual, kelengkapan hashtag/metadata, pencahayaan dan framing

hero_music_studio.alt: Acoustic instruments and creative music studio setup

student_performing.alt: High school student performing acoustic guitar music project

video_filming_camera.alt: Students filming music performance with video camera

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a dual-theme modern, warm-toned full-stack React app with FastAPI backend support for 12 classes (Kelas XI 1 through XI 12).
Implement bilingual support (ID & EN) on /submit page with instant persistent state or context.
Ensure input validation for platforms (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube) with regex checks and live visual platform icon badge.
On successful submission, show exact required success message: 'Your video assignment link has been successfully submitted / Tugas link video Anda berhasil dikirimkan.'
Ensure students NEVER see the raw AI grading in progress on the /submit page.
The Teacher Dashboard (/dashboard) must handle Google login (mocked or real), single-click admin authorization, filtering by class (XI 1 - XI 12), platform, grading status, and instant text search.

Integrate Gemini 3.1 Pro AI grading calculation (or resilient fallback evaluator) using metadata (oEmbed) based on the 3 rubrics: Content & Context 50%, Delivery & Subtitles 30%, Technical & Tagging 20%.
Provide CSV and Excel export functionality for teacher class records.
Implement public results page (/results) with class + attendance lookup and a global toggle switch in Teacher Dashboard settings to enable/disable public access.
Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, tables, toggles, and notification toasts carry the exact data-testid attributes defined above.
